purpose: Validate 2D boundary/rim/liquid/contact/risk fields and contact-transition timing without transparent-object reconstruction or image editing.

stage_1.name: one_factor_at_a_time_sanity
stage_1.rule: nominal plus each non-nominal scalar level; rim offset uses four cardinal directions only

stage_2.name: pairwise_boundary_coverage
stage_2.rule: strength-2 covering array, force all minimum/maximum factor pairs, then Latin-hypercube continuous jitter within adjacent levels

ood_split.rule: No OOD container, optics, dynamics, or role-swap value may appear in train or calibration scenarios.

fields.boundary: one-pixel visible contour plus truncated signed distance field in image space
fields.source_rim: anti-aliased projected rim centerline with occlusion mask
fields.target_rim: anti-aliased projected rim centerline with occlusion mask
fields.liquid_surface: visible projected free-surface boundary with observability mask
fields.stream: visible projected liquid-particle occupancy with observability mask
fields.contact: projected robot-container contact points dilated by 2 pixels
fields.risk: per-pixel probability proxy for future spill or forbidden collision within 0.5 s

anti_artifact_rules: Render native geometry, segmentation IDs, depth, optical flow, and events from the same simulator state; do not inpaint or composite robot hands.
Keep full-scene RGB as the policy observation; labels are auxiliary 2D fields, not edited observations.
Apply transparency/refraction only in the RGB pass; derive labels from physical state and visibility-aware ID/depth passes.
Randomize refractive index, roughness, background, lighting, exposure, and motion blur independently of outcome.
Reject frames whose RGB and label cameras differ by more than 5 ms or 0.25 pixel reprojection error.

event_timeline.state_source: simulator contacts plus liquid flux, not RGB appearance
event_timeline.gwp_alignment: Export event state, time-to-next-transition, and six 2D fields at the same 20 Hz action timestamps used by WAM.

spill.spill_fraction: liquid volume outside both container interiors divided by initial source volume
spill.overflow_fraction: liquid volume crossing target rim after entering target divided by initial source volume

collision.binary_positive_if: any forbidden contact impulse > 0.5 N.s or penetration > 2 mm

task.transfer_fraction: final target liquid volume divided by initial source volume
task.success_if: transfer_fraction >= 0.8 and spill_fraction <= 0.02 and no collision binary positive and both vessels stable for 1.0 s

minimum_baselines: RGB-only action/contact-transition model with no 2D fields
RGB plus source/target rim heatmaps only
RGB plus all oracle simulator 2D fields
RGB plus learned all-field teacher predictions

failure_gates.simulation_integrity: Reject Track B if repeated identical scenarios vary by >5 percentage points in transfer fraction or if mass conservation error exceeds 1% in >1% of rollouts.
failure_gates.field_value: Stop model integration if oracle fields do not improve OOD spill AUPRC by >=0.05 absolute or reduce collision rate by >=20% relative to RGB-only across three seeds.
failure_gates.teacher_value: Stop learned-field integration if it retains <50% of the oracle-field OOD gain or temporal jitter exceeds 4 pixels RMS at 64x64.
failure_gates.real_video_support: Do not claim real stream/contact supervision until dual-label agreement passes the README gates and at least 10 synchronized episodes contain visible stream or physical contact evidence.
